title: Manage end-user OAuth consent for AI agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now offers a Consent portal, a managed web experience and session binding endpoint for AgentCore Gateway. This post walks through provisioning a portal, configuring GitHub and Slack authorization code grant targets, and the end-user consent flow,
reason: AWS announcement of a new product feature (Bedrock AgentCore Identity Consent portal), not a model release. Falls under R3 as a non-model product launch with an official company announcement link.
